description:
## Problem
Six published documentation pages in `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site` describe the released `published-results` PR submission flow: `docs/contributing-results.md`, `docs/reference/cli/submit.md`, `docs/guides/hosted-submission.md`, `docs/reference/hosted-results-contract.md`, `docs/operations/uat-framework.md`, and `docs/operations/uat-methodology.md` (plus `docs/development/adr/adr-published-identifier-field-set.md`). Because these describe behavior that changes with the Step 3 CLI release, they must land on `benchbox-site`'s `next` branch so they reach `main` with that release.

## Change
In a linked worktree of `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site` branched from `origin/next`:
1. Update the six user-facing pages above to target `develop` for bundle PRs, explain that external bundle PRs undergo manual review (never auto-merged) before entering the next `site-inputs` Explorer build, and remove obsolete two-step `published-results` archive guidance.
2. Add a brief dated note on `docs/development/adr/adr-published-identifier-field-set.md` if needed without altering historical context.
3. Verify no broken internal links, MyST constructs, or spelling errors; open a PR targeting `next` and squash-merge once `CI/ci` is green.

## Decision gates
- Target `next` ONLY, never `main`: updating `main` ahead of the Step 3 core release would contradict the released 0.5.x `benchbox submit` CLI.
- Never copy core maintainer-only material (`docs/internal/`, `docs/agent/`) into `benchbox-site`, and never introduce Python or read core files outside `$SITE_INPUTS`.
- If any relative core link changes, regenerate `inventory/core-linked-paths.json` via `npm run inventory:core-links -w website`.

## Verification rubric
- Pass: `npm run lint:docs` (markdownlint + cspell), `npm run docs:check`, and all `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site` `CI/ci` jobs pass on the PR targeting `next`; grep for `published-results` across the six updated pages shows no remaining active instruction to open PRs against `published-results`; PR squash-merged into `next`.
- Fail: PR targets `main` ahead of release, breaks `docs:check` / `llms.txt` / anchor links, or leaves stale `published-results` PR instructions in any of the six pages.

## Guardrails
Follow `benchbox-site/AGENTS.md`: work in a linked worktree of `/Users/joe/Developer/benchbox-site`, never the primary clone; zero Python in `benchbox-site`; stage files by explicit path; commit as `Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>` with no agent/co-author trailers or session/tracker IDs in committed prose; merge with `gh pr merge --squash` once `CI/ci` is green (auto-merge is off in `benchbox-site`).
